
## Summary

**Consolidate repeated Run context and accounting** (residual after DUX5)

Full identity/accounting tables repeat on every dashboard and push primary evidence down.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-05`
- DUX code: `DUX6-14`

## Scope

Overview, Pipeline, Provider, DQ, Trust; Run Explorer remains detailed owner.

Screenshot groups: non-explorer Run context

## Concrete change

Show a compact identity/accounting strip and link to Run Explorer. Keep detailed forensic tables only in the explorer.

## Expected effect

Less scrolling and higher first-screen signal density.

## Acceptance criteria

- Non-explorer dashboards show ≤1 compact row; full details remain reachable in one click.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Stable Run Explorer URL parameters.

## Risk

Users accustomed to inline detail may need transition guidance.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7127 DUX5-14 closed — residual: Run context density under live provision

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing
